The 14-lap race was the tenth round of the 1976 Formula One season and was won by James Hunt.

In the first race of the season at Daytona, 34-year-old George Amick was killed in an accident on the last lap.  In the second race of the season at Trenton, Dick Linder was killed; he was 36 years old.  The third race of the season, the Indy 500, had two fatalities. On July 19 at Mechanicsburg in the Indianapolis Sweepstakes non-championship race Van Johnson was killed in an accident; he was 32 years old. 1984 Italian Grand Prix | The 1984 Italian Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held at Monza on 9 September 1984.  The race, contested over 51 laps, was the fourteenth race of the 1984 Formula One season and was won by Niki Lauda, driving a McLaren-TAG, with local drivers Michele Alboreto and Riccardo Patrese second and third in a Ferrari and an Alfa Romeo respectively.
